comments:
Listed in the group of Phya pa (ID:3831)'s students called the "four noble ones" (jo sras mi bzhi), comprising rNgog ra mo (ID:3847), bSod nams rtse mo (ID:3838), Khu Ne tso (ID:3849), and gNyos dPal le (ID:3850).
He is named in the teaching lineage of the Guhyasamāja, from father to son, listing: gNyos byung po to rDo rje bla ma, gNyos dpal le, and gNyos grags pa dpal, rDo rje gzi brjid (alias sangs rgyas ras chen rgyal ba lha nang pa) ([R894SIKE]: 452-453).
